scenarios.name: Successfully cancel sent friend request
scenarios.description: User cancels an existing outgoing friend request, removing it from both sender's sent list and receiver's pending list.

scenarios.name: Fails when friend request does not exist
scenarios.description: Attempting to cancel a non-existent friend request results in an error message to the user.

sourceReferences.note: Validation: check if sent request exists

scenarios.name: Fails when request exists but target not in pending
scenarios.description: Attempting to cancel a request that is in the sender's sent list but not in the receiver's pending list results in an error.

sourceReferences.note: Validation: check if pending request exists in target
